notes.text: After 47...Kd6, 48.Rd3+ gains time to activate White’s rook. In a depth-27 local line, 48...Kc6 49.Rc3+ leads to a favorable rook trade for White; 47...Kf7 keeps the black king away from the check. A single historical CDB snapshot suggested a bigger difference; current CDB has not been checked.
